in_marathi.name: Bhaaswar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of speech or wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhaaswar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhaaswar is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word ‘bhaas’ meaning speech or wisdom. This name is attributed to the gods Brahma and Vishnu, symbolizing divine speech or knowledge. In Hindu mythology, Bhaaswar is a title given to sages, scholars, and orators, emphasizing the importance of wisdom and eloquence.
